gloss_en: the still and pure air (avir ha-nach ve-ha-zakh) — in Likutey Moharan I:17, the tranquil, purified atmosphere created when love is acquired through giving tzedakah, wherein the spirits (ruchot) of lover and beloved cleave and rest in one another, with no 'bad wind' of hatred separating them; its expanse grows the more people one gives charity to
